index.build_description: Gather resources, build cities and research technologies. Turn your first planet into the heart of an empire.

index.unite_description: Find allies, join alliances and plan joint operations. Together, shift the balance of power across the galaxy.
index.intro_heading: Star Empire is a browser-based space strategy game
index.intro_paragraph_1: Epic battles, many alliances, an endless game world, thousands of opponents - this is only part of what awaits you in the XNova space strategy.
index.intro_paragraph_2: Conquer planets, subdue galaxies, forge an unbreakable alliance of the strongest players! Face your rivals in fierce space battles and dive into the spectacular world of XNova!
